keywords.def: the checklist the teacher uses to mark recitation

questions.q: Self-check: recite Ash-Shams 91:1 to 8 to yourself and give yourself a score for each rubric row.
questions.a: Pupil scores each row 2 to 4 with one target.

questions.q: Half-term check: recite Ash-Shams and a section of Al-Layl to the teacher one by one. While waiting, revise in breakout pairs.
questions.a: Teacher records rubric scores and one target per pupil in the portal; pupils not heard today were heard in this week's rota.

questions.q: Extend: write your break revision plan on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Plan: 10 minutes a day, surahs by day, log ticked.

questions.q: Best way to keep hifdh over the break?
questions.a: A) A little every day. Little and often keeps the Qur'an (the hadith about refreshing it). Cramming or only listening loses it.

questions.q: Which surah comes before Ash-Shams in the mushaf?
Think again: The Ramadan break is four weeks long. What is your plan so you do not forget Al-Layl and Ash-Shams?
questions.a: A daily plan: 10 minutes each day, recite to a parent, tick the log; little and often keeps it.
